name: Eliezer
bio: Eliezer is the second son of Moses and Zipporah, not named until Exodus 18. Moses named him saying, "The God of my father, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh," and so called him "Eliezer," meaning "my God is help" (Exodus 18:4). He and his older brother Gershom were brought by their grandfather Jethro to reunite with Moses in the wilderness (Exodus 18:1-6). (This Eliezer is a different person from Abraham's servant Eliezer, who shares the same name.)
